priceIndex.title: Price index
priceIndex.intro: Aggregated market prices from real catalog, store, quotation, award and purchase-order records. Only aggregates that meet the privacy thresholds are shown; no company or individual price is ever disclosed.
priceIndex.subject: Product / category
priceIndex.noData: No published index yet. Aggregates appear once enough independent data exists.
priceIndex.methodBody: Window: last {days} days. Prices are converted to the unit's base unit and excluded VAT. Outliers outside 1.5×IQR are removed. An aggregate is published only with at least {obs} observations from at least {orgs} independent organizations (for quotations, awards and POs both suppliers and buyers are counted) and no single supplier above {share}% of observations. Test and demo data are excluded. Price types are never mixed.
priceIndex.threshold: Notify when the median moves by (%)
